SECONDARY SCHOOL CERTIFICATE FIRST ANNUAL EXAMINATION, 2025
P(2)
INTRODUCTION
Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education, Gujranwala was established in October 1982 (under the Punjab Boards of Intermediate & Secondary Education Act 1976) in its jurisdiction over six 
districts i.e. Gujranwala, Gujrat, Sialkot, Mandi Baha-ud-Din, Narowal and Hafizabad.
The Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2025 commenced on 04-03-2025 and the written/theory papers ended on 24-03-2025. While the Practical papers countinued till 14-06-2025. Total 
No. of candidates applied for admission to this Examination were 227651.The result is being declared on 24-07-2025.
1.  PROCLAMATION
(i) This Result Gazette is issued as a notice only. Errors and Omissions are accepted. Any entry appearing herein does not independently confer any right or privilege to the candidates for the grant of a 
certificate which will be issued in due course of time under the regulations.
 (ii)  The result of all candidates whether successful or otherwise is being published for convenience of all concerned.
       (iii)The numerical figures given in the result column show the marks obtained by the successful candidates while the abbreviations show the subjects in the result column of gazette in which the              
candidates obtained less than pass marks.
2.  CANCELLED ROLL NUMBERS
The un-alloted roll numbers have been cancelled. Similarly the Roll Numbers of those candidates who were found in-eligible for any other reason have also been cancelled.
3.  CHANCE TO REAPPEAR 
Those candidates:-
             (i)   Who appeared in the Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2025 in full subjects shall have to appear till Secondary School (Second Annual) Examination,2026.
             (Ii)  Who appeared in the Secondary School (Second Annual) Examination, 2025 in full subjects shall have to appear in failing subjects till Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2027.
4.   RESULT LATER CASES
This time, through successful efforts result later cases have been brought to nill. However, some results of those candidates are pending who in spite of repeated reminders have failed to remove 
discrepancies but responsibility lies on such candidate in respect of:-
(i)    Non-adjustment of fee accounts
(ii)   Non-determination of their eligibility.
(iii)  Any other discrepancy already intimated to them.
All such candidates are advised in their own interest to deposit the arrears of fee, if any and to comply with other requirements already intimated without further delay, otherwise the office would not be 
able to release result intimations.
RESULT NOTIFICATION PROCLAMATION
     NOTIFICATION NO. 5663 CE/PA

5.   SUBMISSION OF ADMISSION FORMS
            The Secondary School (Second Annual) Examination, 2,025 is scheduled to be held on 10-09-2025.The candidates who appeared in the (Second Annual) Examination, 2,025 are allowed to 
reappear. The schedule for submission of admission form is as under.
                                                                                   Single Fee  : 25-07-2025 To 07-08-2025
                                                                                                 Double Fee : 08-08-2025 To 11-08-2025
                                                                                                             Triple Fee    : 12-08-2025 To 15-08-2025
6.   CONCESSION
          Candidates failing in any subject to qualify for the grant of the Secondary School Certificates for grant of not more than one percent of the total number of marks allotted to the relevant group have 
been given the benefit for requisite number of marks in the subject in which they have failed so as to enable them just to qualify for the grant of certificate but these have not been physically added in the 
marks obtained by the candidates in the said subject or the aggregate. Thus the aggregate shown in the result card is the real total of the actual marks obtained by the candidates exclusive for the grace 
marks.
7.   RESULT INTIMATION
          (i) Result Intitmation to the successful ad failed regular/private candidates have been dispatced to them under registered cover. No duplication intimation card certificate will be issued except on an 
application made on the prescribed form and a fee i.e. Rs. 1600 deposited for this purpose.
          (ii) Original certificates to the successful regulkar candidates will be sent in due course of time to their respective institutions. The certificate of private candidates will be dispatched on their home 
addresses.

In view of strict measures adopted to curb the tendency of unfair means in the examination, remarkable improvement has been noted. Despite of our vast and comprehensive inspections 
only 34 cases in all could be detected with alleged use of unfair means in the examination halls and complaint received. The numbers of unfair means cases detected this year and so far 
decided are mentioned here under. A judicious procedure has been observed to decide all these cases. Before deciding the cases of alleged use of unfair means, maximum efforts have been 
made to provide fair opportunity of defence to all the candidates involved in such cases. A liberal offer has been made to the candidates to avail the chance of personal interview with 
Discipline committee and it has been ensured that personal hearing is granted to every such candidate who has shown his willingness for this purpose. All the undecided cases are pending 
for want of written reply from the candidates in response to charge sheet issued to them by the office. These candidates have been reminded more than once to submit their statements to 
the office to proceed further in the cases. All of them are hereby advised to submit their written defence to avoid ex-party decision.
